note: S-38 Boże Narodzenie. 'objects': new template objects, left half of each drawing, one string per row; the axis is the last column. Letters as in drawing(): r red, g green, y yellow, b blue, o orange, s gray, k black, n brown. Base rows left empty ('.') are filled by the parts; a variant's top/left place its lines in the frame. 'shapes': dictation-only shapes, '#' a silhouette cell and '.' an empty cell; holes are filled for the outline. Shape levels: lat5 = łatwy (grid 10x14), lat6 = średni (14x17), lat7 = trudny (20x26); a shape lists only its levels. Categories use the ids of OBJECT_CATEGORIES plus the new 'boze-narodzenie'.
